data.headline: Preschool childcare, activity planning and parent communication
data.summary: They work with a preschool group, plan early childhood education activities, support children through transitions and communicate with parents. They use Wilma and Daisy for parent messages and attendance records.

signals.rendering: They work as a childcare assistant with a preschool group of six-year-olds.
They plan weekly activities according to the early childhood education plan.
They lead projects where children collect leaves and practise counting and sorting them.
They created a picture schedule with a child to make outdoor transitions easier.
They discuss the week with parents and use digital tools for parent messages.
They use Wilma for parent communication and attendance records.
They use Daisy for parent communication and attendance records.
